name: Fulton v. City of Philadelphia
summary: The Supreme Court held that Philadelphia's refusal to contract with Catholic Social Services because of its religious objection to certifying same-sex couples as foster parents violated the Free Exercise Clause, as the city's policy was not generally applicable.
significance: Held that Philadelphia violated the Free Exercise Clause by refusing to contract with a Catholic foster care agency that declined to certify same-sex couples, relevant here because it addressed the tension between religious exercise and anti-discrimination requirements in government programs.
